metadata.title: Urban R&B Portrait with Distressed Vertical Typography

retrievalProfile.description: A warm-toned urban portrait featuring a subject in streetwear with a prominent vertical column of distressed, high-contrast typography on a clean white background strip.

recipe.visualDefinition: A medium shot of a male subject in a green baseball cap and white polo, leaning forward against a sun-drenched brick wall. The right side of the frame is a stark white vertical band containing heavy, black, distressed serif text rotated 90 degrees clockwise, overlaid with a thin silver script signature.
coreVisualRelationships: Warm, golden-hour skin tones contrasting with the cool white background strip
Vertical text alignment echoing the vertical lines of the background architecture
Subject's forward-leaning posture creating a diagonal tension against the rigid vertical text column
Heavy distressed block lettering paired with delicate, fluid script overlay
coreInvariants: Vertical text orientation on the right third
Distressed/eroded texture on the primary display font
Warm, high-saturation color grading on the subject
Clean white negative space for typographic clarity

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject occupies the left two-thirds of the frame, medium-close scale, leaning into the center.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and the green cap act as the primary anchor, with the vertical text block as the secondary anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the subject's face, follow the arm down to the hands, then move up the vertical text column on the right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: A distinct white vertical gutter on the right side provides breathing room for the typography.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Warm ochre and terracotta (brick wall and skin tones)
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Pure white (background strip and polo shirt)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the subject area with high value/brightness in the background strip.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to warm earth tones, white, and one primary accent color like green or blue.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Extra-bold slab serif with condensed proportions
letterConstructionRules: Heavy erosion/distress patterns applied to the fill
High contrast between thick and thin strokes
characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters are distressed to look like weathered woodblock or stencil prints
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Aggressive, textured slab serif paired with a light, airy monoline script for contrast.

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the heavy, condensed slab-serif feel with woodblock roots.
Provides the necessary distressed and weathered aesthetic.
Approximates the fluid, handwritten signature overlay.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a portrait of a man in urban streetwear leaning against a sunlit brick wall, leaving the right 30% of the image as a solid white vertical strip.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add vertical, 90-degree rotated distressed slab-serif text in black on the white strip. Overlay a thin silver script signature horizontally across the center of the vertical text.

verificationChecks: Is the text rotated 90 degrees clockwise?
Does the text have a visible weathered/distressed texture?
Is the subject lighting warm and golden?
Is there a clear white vertical gutter on the right?

mustRedesign: Do not use the specific name 'Marques Houston'
Do not replicate the specific 'MH' signature logo
postGenerationChecks: Check that the vertical text is legible despite the distress.
Ensure the script overlay doesn't completely obscure the primary text.
Verify the white strip is pure white and not tinted by the image's warmth.
Confirm the subject's gaze or posture leads toward the typography.
recipe.reuseFormula: Urban Portrait + Warm Grading + [Vertical Distressed Serif] + [Script Overlay] + White Gutter Layout
